name: qBittorrent
description: Download torrents, from a web page.
notes: Keep the suggested web port, 8090: qBittorrent refuses its own page when the two sides differ. Sign in as admin with the temporary password in the app's log, then set your own under Tools → Options → Web UI. Set the download folder to /data/downloads. Give every download app the same Media and downloads folder, with downloads in /data/downloads and your library in /data/media, so finished files move into the library without being copied. The folder must belong to the apps' user (or set APPS_MEDIA_UID and APPS_MEDIA_GID to its owner); point Jellyfin at the library inside it.
